about: Every user-visible string in the OpenArcanum client, by its English text. Generated by scripts/strings from the t()/tn()/N_() calls in ui/js, data-i18n in ui/index.html and the _()/ngettext()/N_() calls in the Python package; do not edit by hand. Translations live beside this file as <language>.json (docs/translations.md).

Shut down: its server was offline for ov.plural: Shut down: its server was offline for over {n} days

This community was shut down (its server.plural: This community was shut down (its server has been offline for over {n} days).

This community was shut down: this compu.plural: This community was shut down: this computer was offline for over {n} days. Bring it back online to register it with the maintainer nodes again.

This computer hosts {n} community. It go.plural: This computer hosts {n} communities. They go offline until you open OpenArcanum again.

{node} belongs to a maintainer network o.plural: {node} belongs to a maintainer network of {n} nodes that share their work. The network's fingerprint is {fingerprint}: check it with the people who run it.
